project: New Super Mario Bros. Wii native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Played into level 1-1 (running, jumping, enemies): 60 fps, no graphics errors seen. Tested on Windows 11 by playing into the first real scene; on the Linux mini PC through the menus. Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
